Title: Azure Active Directory Application Proxy enhancements

Body.Content: Azure Active Directory Application Proxy provides remote access and single sign-on (SSO) for many types of on-premises web applications with the thousands of SaaS applications that Azure AD supports. Its capabilities are expanded by providing SSO for more types of web applications, including Remote Desktop, non-Windows apps, and applications hosted in cloud IaaS platforms. For more information, please see Publish applications using Azure AD Application Proxy.
Body.Markdown:
Azure Active Directory Application Proxy provides remote access and single sign-on (SSO) for many types of on-premises web applications with the thousands of SaaS applications that Azure AD supports. Its capabilities are expanded by providing SSO for more types of web applications, including Remote Desktop, non-Windows apps, and applications hosted in cloud IaaS platforms.

For more information, please see Publish applications using Azure AD Application Proxy .
